decision_scope: whether selected A signals show technically coherent original-versus-corrected waveform and stage behavior worthy of informing the first trained comparison

channel_domains.local_domain_rule: per representation, channels within Euclidean 80 um of that representation's anchor: corrected anchor for corrected_A and state-specific original anchor for original
channel_domains.remap_rule: corrected[target,time] equals original[source,time], where source has (x_source,y_source)=(x_target,y_target+state_um); unmatched targets must be zero

stages.raw_counts: int16 promoted to float64 without scaling
stages.car_centered: temporal_centered minus across-channel median at each time
stages.native_highpass: not recomputed because the retained windows lack the original 512-sample padding; no channel-level high-pass claim is permitted

metrics.robust_noise_sigma: 1.4826 * median(abs(baseline - median(baseline))) per channel and stage
metrics.peak_channel: lowest channel index among exact maxima of channel_ptp_snr
metrics.peak_distance_um: Euclidean distance from peak channel to the representation/state anchor
metrics.local_max_ptp_snr: maximum channel_ptp_snr in the frozen local domain
metrics.local_median_ptp_snr: median channel_ptp_snr in the frozen local domain
metrics.normalized_shape_correlation: Pearson correlation of centered signal vectors on exact remap-corresponding channel/time samples; undefined if either norm is zero

controls_and_comparisons.capture_duplicate_control: bind prior successful duplicate-read control; do not reread or invent a second archived member
controls_and_comparisons.q0_identity: all four q0 original/corrected arrays must be byte-identical
controls_and_comparisons.exact_remap_positive: all 20 corrected arrays must equal the state-specific exact-lattice remap of original, including zero-fill on unsupported targets
controls_and_comparisons.wrong_sign_negative: for each of eight nonzero ordinary slots, wrong-sign-remapped original must have full-array exact-equality fraction below 0.99 versus corrected
controls_and_comparisons.no_shift_negative: for each of eight nonzero ordinary slots, unshifted original must have full-array exact-equality fraction below 0.99 versus corrected
controls_and_comparisons.positive_fixture: synthetic translated spike lands at the expected corrected anchor
controls_and_comparisons.negative_fixture: synthetic wrong-sign and no-shift mappings fail equality

interpretation_rules.unit_usable: at least 2 of its 3 single-event slots are visible in corrected_A
interpretation_rules.PASS: all archive/key/shape/dtype/remap/q0 controls pass, both outcome negative controls pass for all eight ordinary displaced slots, and at least 3 of 4 units are usable
interpretation_rules.CAUTION: all integrity/remap/q0 controls and all negative controls pass, but exactly 2 of 4 units are usable
interpretation_rules.FAIL: any integrity/remap/q0 control fails, any negative control fails, or fewer than 2 units are usable
interpretation_rules.pair_use: short-pair slots are reported for morphology and exact-remap integrity but excluded from visibility and usability counts

stop_conditions: any unexpected key shape axis or dtype
any resource ceiling would be exceeded
completion_condition: all frozen outputs are durable and COMPLETE.json is written last; no recording path is opened
